questions.question: Tell me about your professional background and the kind of work you do best.
What interests you about this position, and how does it fit your experience?
What distinguishes your experience from other candidates applying for this role?
How would you explain your technical strengths and the areas you're still developing?
Describe the responsibilities you handled independently in your previous position.
Walk me through your process for preparing, testing, and deploying an email campaign.
How have you used Automation Studio to support recurring marketing operations?
How do you use SQL queries and Data Extensions when preparing targeted email audiences?
Describe how you've used AMPscript or dynamic content in an email production workflow.
How would you describe your hands-on Journey Builder experience and its limitations?
An email displays correctly on desktop but breaks on mobile. How would you investigate?
A scheduled automation completes without errors, but expected records are missing. What would you check?
A landing page form submits successfully, but the data isn't appearing where expected. How would you troubleshoot it?
How do you approach an unfamiliar technical error when you don't immediately know the solution?
Describe how you would investigate a production issue that cannot be reproduced consistently.
What types of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript changes have you handled professionally?
How do you validate that a web page works correctly across different browsers and screen sizes?
Describe your experience maintaining websites through content management systems.
What experience do you have working with REST APIs, and how have you tested integrations?
How would you approach a web development task involving a framework you haven't used before?
Describe an AI-assisted application you've built and explain which parts you personally validated.
How would you explain the difference between using AI to generate code and independently engineering a solution?
Walk me through an automation workflow you've created using APIs, webhooks, or an orchestration platform.
How would you test an AI-powered workflow before allowing it to process real business information?
What safeguards would you consider when an automation connects several external services?
Tell me about a time you had to learn something quickly to complete an assignment.
Describe a time you discovered a problem during quality assurance. What did you do?
How do you manage competing deadlines when several assignments need your attention?
Tell me about a time you needed clarification or assistance to complete a technical task.
How do you communicate progress, technical limitations, or unexpected delays to stakeholders?
